title: fix(mcp): an action on a sys_* object whose author exposed it to AI is listed and run over MCP, behind every gate
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27681

Clause-②: yes (widening: MCP `list_actions` / `run_action` / `resume_run` now admit a `sys_*` action that declares `ai.exposed: true`; `McpActionSummary` gains the optional `aiExposed`)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6513869839

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：系统对象（`sys_*`）上的动作，只要作者在动作上声明了 `ai: { exposed: true, description }`，就能经 MCP 被列出和执行；未声明的仍按对象名拒绝。
- 为什么改：裁决 B（6513869839）——人和 agent 用同一套系统，暴露与否按动作逐条声明，不再按对象名前缀一刀切；REST 早已对同一调用方开放这些动作。
- 风险与回滚：今天平台没有任何 `sys_*` 动作声明 `ai` 块，所以合入当天行为不变；存储元数据表（带凭据）照旧对 MCP 关闭；回滚即 revert 本 PR。权限、开关、确认、RLS 各闸照旧在后面跑。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `systemObjectActionExposureError`；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `isListableAction` 与 `run_action` 预检；`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` 的 listActions / resume 两处。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/mcp-system-object-action-exposure.test.ts`，预期 11 条全绿（未声明的被拒、声明的过每道闸、存储元数据族表照旧拒绝）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Maintainer ruling 6513869839 (letter B): a `sys_*` action is reachable over MCP only when the action itself declares `ai: { exposed: true, description }` (ADR-0011). Every refusal keyed on the object-name prefix now yields to that flag, and to nothing else.

The card named two guards. On the tree there are **four sites**, and all four now ask one predicate:

| Site | File | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `run_action` (runtime) | `action-execution.ts` `invokeBusinessAction` | `isSystemObjectName` refused every `sys_*` action, ahead of the exposure check | `systemObjectActionExposureError`: refuses only when `ai.exposed !== true` |
| `list_actions` (runtime bridge) | `domains/mcp.ts` `listActions` | skipped every `sys_*` object unconditionally | same predicate |
| `resume_run` admission (runtime bridge) | `domains/mcp.ts` `resumeAdmissionRefusal` | refused every `sys_*` action, 403 | same predicate, still 403 |
| `list_actions` / `run_action` (tool layer) | `mcp-http-tools.ts` | `allowSystemObjects` off ⇒ hidden / refused by name | listed when the bridge attests `aiExposed: true`; `run_action` on an explicit `sys_*` `objectName` is admitted only when `list_actions` would list that action for this caller |

- **The runtime bridge** (`domains/mcp.ts`) had its own unconditional `sys_*` skip in the listing, which the card did not name; without changing it `list_actions` could never show a `sys_*` action. The seat added this file to the claim's surface (amendment 6514100238).
- **`resume_run` is an inference beyond the ruling's text, stated here for the contract review.** `resume_run` is documented as admitted "by the same gates as `run_action`" (`resumeAdmissionRefusal`, #15705), and its own `sys_*` refusal was a copy of `run_action`'s. Leaving it name-keyed would let an agent start an exposed `sys_*` screen flow with `run_action` and then be refused on the screen it was handed. So it takes the same predicate. Nothing else in the resume gate changes.
- **`McpActionSummary.aiExposed`** (optional) is new. The tool layer never sees a declaration, so the bridge attests the author's opt-in on each listed summary; the runtime's `summarizeAction` sets it only when `ai.exposed === true`. A bridge that does not set it keeps every `sys_*` action hidden and refused at the tool layer, exactly as before (fail-closed for third-party bridges of the published `registerActionTools`).
- **The stored-metadata family stays closed, flagged or not.** The full runtime suite showed that the name refusal also carried a second boundary: `stored-metadata-body-reads.test.ts` (#21594) pins that the MCP door never reaches the subject load for `sys_metadata` / `sys_metadata_history`, whose rows hold stored metadata bodies with credential material, even for an `ai.exposed` action. The ruling opened identity actions and named no family table, so the predicate keeps every `isStoredMetadataBodyObject` table refused before the subject load ("…stores metadata bodies and is never exposed via MCP — read and change those through the metadata API"). This is the one place the predicate does not yield to the flag; opening it would be its own decision.
- **Ruling parameter 1 (no deployment bypass):** `allowSystemObjects` stays MCP-side, default false. It opens the tool layer's filter only; the runtime predicate does not read it, so even with it on an undeclared `sys_*` action is refused by the runtime.
- **Unchanged behind the flag:** the ADR-0066 D4 capability gate, the ADR-0126 §8 activation consult, the ADR-0104 D2 param contract, the `ai.requiresConfirmation` gate, the subject load under the caller's RLS, and for a `type: 'api'` action the target endpoint's own authorization. The order of the gates in `invokeBusinessAction` is unchanged.
- **Ruling parameter 2:** no platform `sys_*` action gains an `ai` block here; the declarations follow decision card #27900 (amendment 6513938013). The dogfood case uses a test-only declaration set for one boot.
- **Ruling parameter 3 (the audit row records the MCP surface) is NOT in this PR; it is carried by #27908.** Measured on the tree: neither action door writes an action-invocation audit row. The only per-invocation record is the `console.info` `[action-audit]` line on the script arm (which already names `MCP run_action` vs `REST action`); the `api`, `flow` and declarative-update arms write none. `sys_audit_log` rows are the data writes an action body performs, with no surface column, and `ExecutionContext` has no surface key (`performedBy` is set only at the OAuth `/mcp` door and is lost across the in-process api forward, which re-authenticates). A durable surface field needs `packages/spec` (an attribution key), the audit writer and the forward's headers, which is outside this card's lane. A log line is not offered as the audit row.
- **ADR-0066 D4 closing note:** not in this PR (it is a Tier H path). It is carried by #27956, which runs after this PR merges.
- **Docs (commit `91f77a34`, docs only):** `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx` and `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` stated the old rule, that `sys_*` actions are held back fail-closed. They now give the per-action rule: only an action that declares `ai.exposed: true` itself is admitted; the stored-metadata family stays refused; every later gate is unchanged. `list_actions` items document `aiExposed: true`. The docs families derived for these two paths and `pnpm docs:build` all exit 0 on `91f77a34`. This came from contract-review should-fix 1 (6515376004); claim amendment 6515405353.

### HITL confirmation over MCP, measured before any edit

Wired end to end on `origin/main` `e320e366`: the `run_action` tool declares and forwards `confirm` (`mcp-http-tools.ts`), the bridge passes the whole request through (`domains/mcp.ts` `runAction`), and `invokeBusinessAction` calls `actionConfirmationRefusal` after the param contract and before the subject read and the api forward, answering 428 `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`. Two properties the reviewer should keep in view, both pre-existing and unchanged here: the gate reads only the DECLARED `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` (the listing's `requiresConfirmation` heuristic does not gate), and `confirm: true` is a caller claim (decision batch #54 accepted that model: the gate makes forgetting loud, it does not prove a human). The dogfood case below shows the 428 on a `sys_user` action over the live transport.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-system-object-action-exposure.test.ts` (new, 11): the predicate, including the stored-metadata family staying refused when flagged; listing lists flagged and hides unflagged, D4 still filters the listing; `run_action` refuses the unflagged action with and without `objectName` and dispatches nothing; the flagged one runs, and is refused by D4, by the activation switch (409 `ACTION_DISABLED`) and by the confirmation gate (428) before dispatch, then runs confirmed.
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-resume-run.test.ts` (+2): on a `sys_*` object a flagged flow action's run resumes; an unflagged one's run is refused 403 with the system-object refusal and the engine is not asked.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-system-object-exposure.test.ts` (new, 8, through `MCPServerRuntime.handleHttpRequest`): attested listed / unattested hidden; a bridge that attests nothing stays closed; `allowSystemObjects: true` keeps its meaning; `run_action` refuses an unattested, an unlisted and a same-named-other-object action before the bridge runs, admits the attested one; an ordinary object is not screened.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-system-object-action-exposure.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 6, showcase + better-auth admin + live `/mcp`): `ban_user` with a test-only `ai: { exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true }`; `list_actions` lists it (and not `unban_user`); `unban_user` refused by name with and without `objectName`; unconfirmed `ban_user` 428 and the user stays unbanned; switched off ⇒ 409 even confirmed; a plain member's confirmed call refused; the confirmed admin call bans.
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts`: the standalone `sys_api_key` row pinned as refused carried `ai: { exposed: true }`; the ruling reverses exactly that, so the fixture is now unflagged (the flagged case lives in the new file). A moved pin, named here for review.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-execution-destructive.test.ts`: the "gate 1" pin moved from `isSystemObjectName` to the per-action predicate (the 13 identity actions are excluded because none declares `ai.exposed`).

## Acceptance notes

- Branch is the card thread's platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-qid1f1`, not `claude/issue-27681-*`.
- A `run_action` call on an explicit `sys_*` `objectName` now reads the bridge's listing once before running. It is the tool layer's only view of the declaration; calls on ordinary objects are not affected.
- An exposed `sys_*` action the caller cannot see in its own listing (capability missing, handler unbound) is refused at the tool layer with the system-object sentence, which names both conditions, rather than with the runtime's narrower reason.
- No ADR anchor file is added; the ruling and ADR-0011 are cited in the code at the predicate.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

Run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, every leg committed first; the dogfood leg went through `packages/runtime/dist` (`ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present on the mutation leg, `--absent` after the rebuild).

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | predicate no longer yields to `ai.exposed` | runtime new file 7 red |
| A2 | `invokeBusinessAction` guard deleted | 2 red (unflagged refused by the wrong refusal) |
| A3 | runtime listing back to the name-only skip | 2 red |
| A4 | resume admission back to name-only | 2 red |
| A5 | tool-layer list filter ignores `aiExposed` | mcp new file 2 red |
| A6 | tool-layer `run_action` pre-check removed | 3 red |
| A7 | `summarizeAction` stops attesting `aiExposed` | 1 red |
| A8 | A1 through `dist`, dogfood | 4 of 6 red (list, 428, 409, confirmed ban) |
| A9 | stored-metadata family exemption disabled | 3 red (both #21594 pins + the new one) |

</details>

All on head `55f4e186` (the code head; `origin/main` merged once at `709dba37`). The final head `91f77a34` adds the docs-only commit above and no code.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 481 files, 7842 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed. (The first full run, before the stored-metadata fix, was 3 red: the two #21594 family pins and the standalone `sys_api_key` pin; that run is what found the family boundary.)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: 46 files, 594 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (both with `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Dogfood: `mcp-system-object-action-exposure.dogfood.test.ts` + `api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts`: 14/14. The full battery is not owed (no `!`, no `(narrowing)`).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/runtime/src packages/mcp/src` plus the new dogfood file: exit 0, no findings.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 65 derived, 65 run, every exit 0; `--ran` reconcile: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed eight dists built first (a prerequisite, not a verdict) and `check:type-check-debt` was rerun under the verify lock.
- `git merge-tree` against the open PRs whose diffs touch these packages (#27915, #27713, #27793): all clean; only #27915 shares a file (`action-execution.ts`), in a different region.
